name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate

entry.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; building applications with large language models
entry.audience: Developers and data scientists building applications on large language models

reading.cost: The page shows 'Join for Free' and states no other price.
covers: Machine learning and deep learning with Python
Transformers such as BERT and LLMs such as GPT and LLaMA
Building and deploying AI applications with Flask and Python libraries
reading.format: An online 16 course series with hands on labs, projects, practical evaluations and a guided project. The page says it takes about 6 months and is available in 19 languages.
reading.summary: The IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a 16 course series offered by IBM on Coursera. It covers generative AI, large language models and natural language processing, with hands on work building and deploying AI applications. The page says learners who finish earn an employer recognized certificate from IBM and complete a guided project that produces a real world gen AI application.
reading.audience: The page says it is for aspiring gen AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers and AI research engineers. It is listed at beginner level and the page states no prior experience is required.
reading.prerequisites: The page states no prior experience is required. It is listed as beginner level with recommended experience.
